episodes.synopsis: The invincible hitman, Fable, is ordered by the boss to live an ordinary life in Osaka for a year.
episodes.title: Moving

episodes.synopsis: Akira and Yoko start their new life in Osaka, but trouble always seems to find them.
episodes.title: A Wonderful Night

episodes.synopsis: Akira runs the risk of disobeying orders while minding his own business.
episodes.title: Tag

episodes.synopsis: Sparks fly between Akira, who wants to live in peace, and Ebihara, who wants the hitman out.
episodes.title: Chatting About Life

episodes.synopsis: In his quest to live an ordinary life, Akira begins the seemingly impossible task of finding a job.
episodes.title: You Listening to Me?!

episodes.synopsis: Kojima becomes increasingly resentful at changes to the Maguro Group while he was in prison.
episodes.title: Prison Release Jamboree

episodes.synopsis: With growing frustration, Kojima takes advantage of Ebihara's absence to make his move.
episodes.title: Realist

episodes.synopsis: Yoko sets her sights on a playboy womanizer who shows up at the bar where she hangs out.
episodes.title: Because I'm...You know!

episodes.synopsis: As Kojima's rampage escalates, Ebihara tries to get Akira to keep an eye on him.
episodes.title: You Mean a Hitman...?

episodes.synopsis: When Akira finds out that Misaki is in trouble, he goes into action to get her out of it.
episodes.title: The Phantom of the Balcony

episodes.synopsis: Akira, Yoko, Kojima, and Sunagawa all prepare for what will be an explosive encounter.
episodes.title: The Fated Day

episodes.synopsis: Hindered by his order not to kill, Akira still puts his rescue plan into motion.
episodes.title: There's Always Someone Better

episodes.synopsis: Akira returns with Kojima, but now Ebihara faces a hard decision to keep the peace of the Group.
episodes.title: Aniki...Aniki...

episodes.synopsis: Akira lets Kuroshio, who knows the truth about Fable, tag along for a two-night survival adventure.
episodes.title: I Love You, Nii-san!

episodes.synopsis: Akira and Kuroshio's survival adventure in the mountains drives Kuroshio to the edge of sanity.
episodes.title: Survival Traning?

episodes.synopsis: One battleground, the woods, the other, a bar. Both will echo with sounds of fierce combat tonight.
episodes.title: Mountaineer Man

episodes.synopsis: From a Taihei detective agency, a dark force is at work, disturbing Akira's peaceful life.
episodes.title: Rei Utsubo

episodes.synopsis: Utsubo and his associates approach Misaki as they proceed with their nefarious plans.
episodes.title: Cheerio

episodes.synopsis: Akira finds out a surprising fact during a delivery, and Utsubo and his crew make their next move.
episodes.title: Lies and Falsehoods

episodes.synopsis: Utsubo exposes Kainuma's stalking, causing Kainuma to turn his ire on Misaki.
episodes.title: 24 Hours

episodes.synopsis: After discovering who Fable is, Utsubo begins working out a plan to kill Akira.
episodes.title: The ABCs of Villainy

episodes.synopsis: Utsubo and Suzuki put into motion their carefully laid plans to kill Fable, their foe.
episodes.title: Doorstep Man

episodes.synopsis: Akira proves harder than expected to kill, and Utsubo runs into trouble preparing the next trap.
episodes.title: Horn

episodes.synopsis: Suzuki and Akira work desperately to save Hinako, and Utsubo puts his final plan into action.
episodes.title: Starry Sky Lullaby

episodes.synopsis: Isaki arranges for a getaway car but runs into a snag. Otherwise, life goes on for everyone else.
episodes.title: Imagination Man
